```{r}
# shared body for every member page; the page's params$slug picks the member
source("R/helpers.R")
statutes <- load_statutes()
edges    <- load_edges()
m        <- load_members()[[params$slug]]
short_of <- stats::setNames(statutes$short, statutes$id)
links    <- official_links(statutes)

s_links <- function(ids, subject = FALSE) {
  paste(statute_md(unlist(ids), short_of, prefix = "../statutes/", subject = subject), collapse = ", ")
}
src <- function(x) paste0("[", x$label, "](", x$url, ")")
bill <- function(x) if (is.null(x$bill)) "" else
  paste0(" [", bill_label(x$bill$type, x$bill$number), "](", bill_url(x$bill$congress, x$bill$type, x$bill$number), ")")
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(m$seat, ". ", m$party, ".\n\n", m$background, "\n\n", sep = "")
cat(
  "::: {.callout-note}\n",
  "This page is an independent reference built from public sources. It is not affiliated with, ",
  "endorsed by, or produced for the member's office. It describes committee roles and the public record ",
  "so the wiki can be read from that vantage point, and it takes no position on them. ",
  "Bill numbers link to Congress.gov; statements link to the member's official site where one exists. ",
  "Last reviewed ", m$as_of, ".\n:::\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat("Profile sources: ", paste(purrr::map_chr(m$profile_sources, src), collapse = "; "), ".\n", sep = "")
```

## Committee jurisdiction

Each committee seat maps to a slice of the wiki. The lists below are the statutes most central to that committee's work.

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (cm in m$committees) {
  cat("### ", cm$name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("**Role.** ", cm$role, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("**Jurisdiction.** ", cm$jurisdiction, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("**Core statutes.** ", s_links(cm$statutes), ".\n\n", sep = "")
  title_ids <- intersect(paste0("title", cm$code_titles, "-usc"), statutes$id)
  cat(
    "**Code titles.** ", s_links(title_ids), ". Source: ", src(cm$source), ".\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```

## Lens graph

Committees, record, and district interests, connected to the statutes they touch. Statute-to-statute links from the main graph are included where both ends appear here. Click to highlight, double-click a statute to open its page.

```{r}
# one row per lens item (committee, initiative, or district interest)
lens_items <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  purrr::map(m$committees,  \(x) tibble::tibble(id = paste0("m-", x$id), label = x$short, kind = "Committee", statutes = list(unlist(x$statutes)))),
  purrr::map(m$initiatives, \(x) tibble::tibble(id = paste0("m-", x$id), label = x$short, kind = "Record", statutes = list(unlist(x$statutes)))),
  purrr::map(m$equities,    \(x) tibble::tibble(id = paste0("m-", x$id), label = x$short, kind = "District interest", statutes = list(unlist(x$statutes))))
)

kind_shape <- c("Committee" = "box", "Record" = "diamond", "District interest" = "star")
kind_color <- c("Committee" = "#1b2a41", "Record" = "#c2571a", "District interest" = "#6b7d2a")

lens_edges <- purrr::map2(lens_items$id, lens_items$statutes, \(id, s) tibble::tibble(from = id, to = s)) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()

used <- unique(lens_edges$to)

nodes <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  # the member at the center
  tibble::tibble(id = "member", label = m$short, group = "Member", shape = "ellipse",
                 color = "#1b2a41", value = 30L, font.color = "#ffffff", title = m$name, url = NA_character_),
  lens_items |>
    dplyr::transmute(id, label, group = kind, shape = unname(kind_shape[kind]),
                     color = unname(kind_color[kind]), value = 12L,
                     font.color = dplyr::if_else(kind == "Committee", "#ffffff", "#1b2a41"),
                     title = paste0("<b>", label, "</b><br>", kind), url = NA_character_),
  statutes |>
    dplyr::filter(id %in% used) |>
    dplyr::transmute(id, label = short, group = "Statute", shape = "dot",
                     color = unname(domain_colors[domain]), value = 6L, font.color = "#1b2a41",
                     title = paste0("<b>", title, "</b><br>", year, " | ", status_label,
                                    "<br><i>Double-click to open the page</i>"),
                     url = paste0("../statutes/", id, ".html"))
)

vis_edges <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(from = "member", to = lens_items$id, color = "#8a94a3", dashes = FALSE, arrows = "", title = lens_items$kind),
  lens_edges |> dplyr::mutate(color = "#8a94a3", dashes = FALSE, arrows = "to", title = "touches"),
  edges |>
    dplyr::filter(from %in% used, to %in% used) |>
    dplyr::transmute(from, to, color = unname(relation_colors[relation]), dashes = TRUE,
                     arrows = dplyr::if_else(relation == "related", "", "to"),
                     title = paste0(short_of[from], " <b>", relation_labels[relation], "</b> ", short_of[to], "<br>", note))
)

menu_style <- "width: 46%; max-width: 260px; height: 32px;"

visNetwork::visNetwork(nodes, vis_edges, width = "100%", height = "720px") |>
  visNetwork::visNodes(
    font = list(size = 20, strokeWidth = 0),
    scaling = list(min = 12, max = 34, label = list(enabled = TRUE, min = 18, max = 26)),
    margin = 8
  ) |>
  visNetwork::visEdges(width = 1.4, smooth = list(type = "continuous")) |>
  visNetwork::visOptions(
    highlightNearest = list(enabled = TRUE, degree = 1),
    nodesIdSelection = list(enabled = TRUE, main = "Find an item", style = menu_style),
    selectedBy = list(variable = "group", main = "Filter by type", style = menu_style)
  ) |>
  visNetwork::visPhysics(
    solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
    forceAtlas2Based = list(gravitationalConstant = -120, springLength = 140),
    stabilization = list(iterations = 400)
  ) |>
  visNetwork::visLayout(randomSeed = 6) |>
  visNetwork::visInteraction(navigationButtons = FALSE, tooltipDelay = 120) |>
  visNetwork::visEvents(
    doubleClick = "function(p) {
      if (p.nodes.length) {
        var url = this.body.data.nodes.get(p.nodes[0]).url;
        if (url) { window.location.href = url; }
      }
    }"
  ) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("function(el) { if (window.wikiWatchGraph) window.wikiWatchGraph(el); }")
```

Boxes are committees, diamonds are items in the record, stars are district interests, and circles are statutes colored by domain. Solid lines connect a lens item to a statute; dashed lines are statute-to-statute relationships.

## Record mapped to statutes

Bills, resolutions, letters, and public statements, newest first, with the existing law each one works through or would change.

```{r}
purrr::map(m$initiatives, \(x) tibble::tibble(
  Date = x$date,
  Item = paste0(x$title, bill(x)),
  Type = x$kind,
  Summary = gsub("\\s+", " ", x$summary),
  `Existing law` = s_links(x$statutes),
  Source = src(x$source)
)) |>
  purrr::list_rbind() |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Date)) |>
  knitr::kable(format = "pipe")
```

## District interests mapped to statutes

```{r}
purrr::map(m$equities, \(x) tibble::tibble(
  Interest = x$title, Summary = gsub("\\s+", " ", x$summary),
  `Relevant law` = s_links(x$statutes), Source = src(x$source)
)) |>
  purrr::list_rbind() |>
  knitr::kable(format = "pipe")
```

## Watch list for these committees

Statutes in the committee lists above that have lapsed, partly expired, or been repealed, or whose status note asks to check current status. These are the places where a deadline, a gap in law, or a compliance dispute creates work for the committees.

```{r}
committee_ids <- unique(unlist(purrr::map(m$committees, "statutes")))

statutes |>
  dplyr::filter(id %in% committee_ids, status != "in-force" | grepl("Check current status", status_note)) |>
  dplyr::transmute(Statute = statute_md(id, short_of, prefix = "../statutes/"), Status = status_label,
                   `Where it stands` = gsub("\\s+", " ", status_note)) |>
  knitr::kable(format = "pipe")
```

## Editing this page

Everything above is generated from `data/members/`, `r m$slug`.yml. Edit that file and render to update the page and its graph; add a new file to add a member.
